profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer (Android)
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Engineer and technologist currently focused on Android.

positions.title: Senior Android Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Contributed to the development of the Fitbit WearOS app, primarily fixing bugs and polishing features in preparation for the app's major release in Fall of 2023.
* Worked with a small team to review, triage, and prioritize bug reports
* Created detailed reports on findings for visual, logic, or performance issues
* Implemented code changes using the latest Android coding standards and patterns
* Added unit tests to prove bug fixes and increase code coverage
* Contributed to code reviews to catch issues early and ensure high code quality
positions.insights: Skills: Android Development · Android Studio · Bug Tracking · Piper · Kotlin

positions.title: Senior Android Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on various teams to develop assorted features for the native Android app for the world’s largest retailer.
* Worked with designers, product owners, and engineering managers in SCRUM methodology to scope, plan, and distribute work.
* Refactored existing code to support new functionality as required by product designs.
* Migrated legacy Java code to Kotlin as needed.
* Wrote unit and integration tests with MockK, JUnit, and Espresso to ensure code quality.
* Conducted extensive code reviews across different teams.
* Laid the groundwork for high-level architecture patterns that would facilitate feature component reuse.
positions.insights: Skills: Android Studio · Android Testing · Git · Android Development · Scrum

positions.title: Lead Android Engineer
positions.description:
Lead the development and enhancement of the Reverb Android app.
* Took over, maintained, and enhanced an existing Java code base.
* Worked with design, product, and engineering to plan, scope, and estimate work.
* Implemented new features using the latest Android SDKs, technologies, and best practices.
* Introduced Kotlin, MVVM, Databinding, and other modern Android development strategies.
* Refactored outdated code as necessary to improve code quality and pay technical debt.
* Mentored other developers and performed extensive code reviews.
* Wrote unit and UI tests with Mockito, MockK, JUnit, and Espresso to ensure code quality.
* Set up and maintained a Jenkins instance to run tests, do deploys, and update screenshots.
* Managed the app on Google Play including replying to user reviews.
* Wrote and maintained documentation on processes and rationales for decisions made.
* Used Crashlytics to monitor app stability and quickly address crashes or other bugs.
positions.insights: Skills: Android Studio · Android Testing · Kotlin · Android Development · Android SDK

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description: Collaborated with a small team to develop the Android version of a mobile app for a major brand.
positions.insights: Skills: Android Studio · Jira · Android Development · Java · Android SDK

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for developing, maintaining, and enhancing multiple apps built for in-house use. Includes a tablet-optimized Android app and a phone app built natively for both Android (Java / Eclipse) and iOS (Objective C / XCode).

Key features include custom themes based on Android 4.0+ Holo, fragments, action bars, SQL databases for local storage, web service connectivity with JSON web services over HTTP, location services, and taking / attaching photos and videos, among other features and functionality.
positions.insights: Skills: Android Studio · Eclipse · Android Development · Java · Android SDK

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Lead developer of a real-time trading and analytics Windows C# application.

Responsible for the complete software development cycle of the project: gathered feature requests and feedback; wrote technical specifications; implemented new features; maintained, updated, and refactored existing code; worked with QA to create, maintain, and update test plans; managed beta and production releases; provided technical support to traders using the software.
positions.insights: Skills: Perforce · Visual Studio · C++ · Jira · C#

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to an unannounced, open world, AAA title using a highly modified version of the Unreal Engine 3.

Extended the base create-a-player feature to support design requirements.

Wrote documentation, scripts, and code updates to facilitate artists’ work flow using custom UI tool.

Assisted in other areas as necessary, including contributions to AI, animation, gameplay features, testing, and porting code from other projects.
positions.insights: Skills: Perforce · C++ · Game Development · PS3 · Xbox 360

positions.description:
Def Jam: Icon (PS3 / XBox 360)
 * Assisted with gameplay camera system.
 * Assisted with implementing sound effects.
 * Assisted with testing and debugging online functionality.

Marvel (PS3 / XBox 360 / Wii) (canceled)
 * Lead design and implementation of gameplay camera system and its integration into our animation tool
 * Developed C# graphical user interface for data previewing and manipulation

projects.title: TreKing
projects.description:
Designing and developing TreKing, a mobile app for navigating Chicago public transportation.
App carries a 4.5+ rating and is one of Google Play's top-selling Transportation apps:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/category/TRANSPORTATION/collection/topselling_paid

Android version developed with Java, Android Studio, and the Android SDK. Makes use of the Android compatibility library, Holo theme, action bar pattern, services, notifications, widgets, Google Maps V2, fragments, location services, and network connectivity over HTTP to various endpoints including XML and JSON, among other features and functionality.

App is backed by a server developed with C#, Visual Web Developer, and ASP.NET using an SQL database.

A native port for iOS is under development using Xcode and Objective C.
